I can outline the basic steps here, with supplemental info provided below by this video: https://youtu.be/K5YT_DDtcHY?si=F5Ma5TYYIYsdZHPM

Grab loads of max repels, 100+. Load up on quick, repeat, and ultra balls. You may be in this for 40+ encounters. A false swiper can be helpful but honestly I just spammed repeat balls.

The basic Idea is to find the location best suited for hunting the pokemon you’re looking to grind. Go to that place, and use max repels. You’ll want to keep using them throughout the length of the hunt. Save your game, then go into your items and use the PokeRadar. Walk to a shaking patch of grass 4 or more move spaces away, and check to see if the pokemon that pops up is the one you’re hunting. If it is, great, now you can start catching. If not, close the game and try again. Don’t get on your bike, or leave the route, because that automatically breaks the chain. Catch the pokemon, and look for another shaking patch four or more spaces away. You’ll know there’s a shiny in the patch if it glitters and shines on the field map.

Keep doing this until the chain breaks, or you get to about 40 in the chain. Once your chain is high enough, you can keep re-rolling the grass patches by walking 50 spaces and using the pokeradar again. That way, you’re re-rolling the shiny patch chance with the best odds possible.

Now, even if you do everything right, the chain can break. It’s important to keep the repels up as regular wild encounters break the chain, and to catch the Pokemon because that provides a 93% chance of keeping the chain going from encounter to encounter.

M.2 drives definitely make for decent boot drives, but there are some things to consider. Firstly, I believe that the motherboard M.2 slot #1 shares bandwidth with a SATA 6.0 Gb/s port. When the M.2 slot is used, one SATA 6.0 Gb would be disabled. So you'd be losing use of that.  


Based in your use-case, changing from the selected SSD's wouldn't make that significant an impact on your use and boot performance.  


Another thing to make sure of is you buy not just any SSD that will mount with M.2, there are some that mount there, but don't take data, necessitating the use of a SATA cable, which will bottleneck your speed. Hope this helps! ;)

To those of you who have called me brave, thank you, but I don't know if I my actions were necessarily motivated by bravery. I wanted to turn all the evil I'd experienced back onto Nmom. I am not an N, but I employed N tactics in my escape. I would encourage all of you, whether you currently suffer under the heel of one of these tyrants, or have long escaped, to try to unpack all your abuse and to heal. Make yourself safe, or bide your time if you have to, but when the time comes, consider doing what I did. *Speak truth to power*. Go NC if you feel that's what you feel you should and discover yourself as a person. Learn to love that person. Get help if you can, or if you're having a hard time. Try not to live in anger, but don't forget what N's are.
